dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a smooth parabolic curve from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, categorized as acute based on the convergence of leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear slope relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Pronounced convex curvature with a large radius forming a distinct, rounded melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a length approximately equal to its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum.
